map.格式 ^\\d{2}-\\d{7}$，且前两位须为 IRS 分配的有效 EIN: Format ^\d{2}-\d{7}$, and the first two digits must be a valid IRS-assigned EIN prefix
map.依据 IRS 规则校验 9 位美国雇主识别号(EIN)的格式与结构合法性；仅校验: Per IRS rules, validate the 9-digit US Employer Identification Number (EIN)'s format and structural legality; format check only, not authenticity.
map.校验 9 位 EIN 的格式、数字与前缀分区: Validate the 9-digit EIN's format, digits and prefix zone
map.企业开户、报税前核对雇主识别号: Verify the EIN before corporate account opening or tax filing
map.区分 EIN 与 SSN 的格式差异: Distinguish EIN from SSN format differences
map.示例：EIN 格式与前缀分区: Example: EIN format and prefix zones
map.输入 12-3456789，页面校验 9 位数字与前两位 IRS 前缀分区；位数: Enter 12-3456789; the page checks 9 digits and the first two IRS prefix zone; wrong length or characters prompt a format error.
map.EIN 格式要求是什么？: What are the EIN format requirements?
map.9 位数字，通常写作 XX-XXXXXXX，前两位为 IRS 校区前缀，页面据此: 9 digits, usually written XX-XXXXXXX, the first two being the IRS campus prefix; the page judges structural legality from this.
map.EIN 有校验位吗？: Does EIN have a check digit?
map.EIN 没有公开的算术校验位，页面主要校验长度、数字格式与前缀分区是否落在有效范: EIN has no public arithmetic check digit; the page mainly checks length, digit format and whether the prefix zone falls in a valid range.
map.校验通过代表企业存在吗？: Does passing validation mean the company exists?
map.不代表。企业是否持有有效 EIN 须在 IRS 官方渠道确认。: No. Whether the company holds a valid EIN must be confirmed through official IRS channels.

map.口径：剥离空格/连字符等分隔符后须为 9 位数字（回显归一化为 XX-XXXXX: Rule: after stripping spaces, hyphens and other separators, the input must be 9 digits (echo normalized to XX-XXXXXXX); the first two digits must be a valid EIN prefix (reserved ranges 00/07/08/09/17/18/19/28/29/49/69/70/79/89/97 are invalid). EIN has no check digit: only format and structure are checked, not real registration status.
